description: Messy site: no custom properties, colors only as shorthand hex (#e63) and rgb() in style blocks plus inline style attributes, fonts only via inline styles, no logo (favicon link only).

colors.note: no role naming anywhere — promoted to primary by chromatic frequency
used as text-on-primary; role 'text' is the extractor's defensible read
body text color loses the single text role slot to the more frequent #ffffff
dark brown reads as near-black neutral; dropped by the one-color-per-role merge

known_gaps: Generic fallback font 'Arial' leaks through extraction (not in the system-font blocklist) — measured font precision 2/3, threshold set to 0.6.
Dark text colors #222222 and #40312a are extracted but lost to the one-color-per-role merge.
